name: Hydrogen-precharged 304L stainless-steel tensile test at 20 K
plain_name: Hydrogen-precharged 304L stainless-steel tensile test at 20 K
description: Measure monotonic tensile behavior of hydrogen-precharged stainless steel relevant to liquid-hydrogen transport/storage materials; charging precedes the cryogenic tensile test.

sources.citation: PNNL, Effect of Hydrogen on Tensile Properties of 304L Stainless Steel at Cryogenic Temperatures

reported_equipment: Cryogenic tensile testing apparatus described by PNNL

requirements.rationale: The selected reported specimen test point is 20 K; a base-temperature bound alone cannot establish this operating point.
A calibrated load frame and cryogenic specimen grips are essential.

missing_information: Hydrogen precharge concentration/profile, specimen geometry, load capacity, strain rate and temperature stability must be confirmed. No in-situ high-pressure hydrogen capability is assumed.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
